packing: All GLBs: EXT_meshopt_compression + KHR_mesh_quantization (gltf-transform meshopt); textures are WebP (EXT_texture_webp), max 1024 px. KTX2 was NOT used: toktx could not be installed in the asset session (no package, building KTX-Software from source was not permitted), so textures are WebP - three.js GLTFLoader reads EXT_texture_webp natively; the KTX2Loader in models.js is simply unused for these files.

models/real/anims.glb.author: Quaternius
models/real/anims.glb.description: Animation-only GLB (armature nodes, no mesh) on the shared Mixamo-named rig. Retargeted in Blender from the Universal Animation Library 1 + 2 mannequin rig (world-space rotation transfer from a T-pose reference, hips translation scaled to the 1.76 m reference body), 30 fps, resampled + meshopt.

clips.name: fall
clips.from: UAL1 Jump_Loop (same motion as jump; no dedicated fall clip in the library)

clips.name: dodge
clips.from: UAL1 Roll (in place, no root motion)

clips.name: wave
clips.from: authored here: UAL1 Idle_Loop body + procedural right-arm wave (no wave clip exists in UAL 1/2)

clips.name: cheer
clips.from: authored here: UAL1 Idle_Loop body + procedural both-arms-up pump (no cheer clip exists in UAL 1/2)

models/real/anims.glb.notes: Bind with THREE.AnimationMixer on any of the three characters (tracks target nodes by name). Clips contain rotation tracks for all joints plus a position track on the hips (in place, no root motion); the hips height was baked for the 1.76 m body, so on the 1.70 m woman the hips sit ~3 cm lower than her own rest height (visually fine; strip or scale the hips .position track if needed). Verified headless: every clip plays on all three characters (preview/chars-walk.png, preview/anim-clips.png).

models/real/cars/coupe.glb.description: Realistic unbranded concept sports coupe. Source 138k tris (after removing variants) -> 10,605 tris: interior (except seats/floor), engine, axles, brake parts, wipers and licence plate deleted, then Blender decimate.
models/real/cars/coupe.glb.notes: Metres, Y up, wheels on y=0, centred on x/z. Nose points +Z (same as the characters' facing). Materials: "Paint 1 Carmine" and "Paint 2 Carmine" are the body paint (MeshPhysicalMaterial with clearcoat) - recolour them for variety; "Glass" is alpha-blended dark glass (transmission removed for phones); lights use emissive. All Khronos/3D Commerce logo textures (licence plate, tyre sidewall text) were stripped and KHR_materials_variants removed. Width includes mirrors. Decimation leaves some faceting on curved panels and rims.
